name: proseharbor-editor
description: ProseHarbor Editor monorepo：核心编辑器 / Vue 3 适配层 / 文档 / 演示

scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach -A --topological-dev --exclude proseharbor-editor run build
scripts.build:packages: yarn workspaces foreach -A --topological-dev --exclude proseharbor-editor --exclude proseharbor-docs --exclude proseharbor-playground run build
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude proseharbor-editor run typecheck
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude proseharbor-editor exec rimraf dist
scripts.publish:packages: yarn workspaces foreach -A --no-private --topological-dev npm publish --access public
